Good to know

Marketing questions

What does GB GROUP's advertising service include? +

Outdoor hoardings and print material, social and digital campaigns, on-ground activation, and brand identity work such as logos, profiles and signage.

Which businesses do you work with? +

Retailers and showrooms, manufacturers, educational institutes, real estate developers, healthcare providers, startups and local service businesses.

Can you run campaigns in both states? +

Yes. We plan and execute campaigns across Jharkhand and West Bengal, from city-level outdoor placements to local promotional drives.

How do I get a campaign proposal? +

Share your business type, target cities and goal in the enquiry form. Our team will discuss scope and indicative costs directly with you.
